blocks.task_summary: Given u1 = 50 and u4 = 86.4 of a geometric sequence, find the common ratio r, set up the sum inequality Sn > 33 500, and solve for the smallest integer n.
method_path: Solve for n by GDC sketch, logarithmic manipulation, or trial of S26 and S27
accepted_alternatives: Solve the inequality by GDC sketch or by computing S26 = 28 368.8 and S27 = 34 092.6 directly, rather than algebraic manipulation with logarithms.

evidence.basis: 86.4 = 50r^3 (A1); r = (86.4/50)^(1/3) = 1.2 seen anywhere (A1); 50(1.2^n - 1)/0.2 > 33500 OR 250(1.2^n - 1) > 33500 (A1); attempt to solve their geometric Sn inequality or equation (M1); sketch OR n > 26.9045, n = 26.9 OR S26 = 28368.8 OR S27 = 34092.6 OR algebraic manipulation involving logarithms; n = 27 (accept n >= 27) A1.
